description: With no voice provider connected, pressing 'Call Elio' opens Settings > Voice with no sentence saying why. The composer is not updated either. After closing, the chat is unchanged and nothing says a provider is needed or what Elio is. A first-time user who has never heard of Elio asked for a call and got an API-key form for ElevenLabs/OpenAI/Cartesia/Fish Audio.
expected: The user learns that a voice provider is needed before a call can start (shown only at that moment), and that Elio is the voice agent, not Chief.
actual: Dialog titled 'Voice' with Providers list, 'API key' field and disabled Connect. No mention of Elio or the call. Closing returns to an unchanged chat.
suggested_fix: When Call Elio opens Voice settings, show one short line in the dialog (for example 'Connect a voice provider to call Elio'), only in that case. Keep it out of normal Settings > Voice visits. Per repo copy rules, justify the line in the PR.

description: On desktop the Voice dialog shows a right pane holding only a bare API key field and a greyed Connect button before any provider is selected. No provider is highlighted, so it is unclear which provider the key belongs to. Roughly 70% of the dialog is empty.
expected: Key field and Connect appear after a provider is chosen, or a provider is preselected.
actual: API key input and disabled Connect are visible with no provider selected.
suggested_fix: Hide the key field until a provider is selected, or preselect the first provider.

description: The 'Call Elio' mic button measured 32x32px on desktop and mobile (below 44px target). Hovering it for 1 second showed no visible tooltip in the screenshot, though the story expects one. The icon is a filled mic in a ring, so it also reads as 'dictate', not 'call another agent'.
expected: Visible tooltip on hover; label that distinguishes calling Elio from dictation.
actual: No tooltip captured; accessible name is 'Call Elio' only.
suggested_fix: Confirm the tooltip renders on hover in the browser (it may need a longer delay); consider a phone icon instead of a mic.

description: The story file says to choose the offline 'Scripted' provider in Settings > Voice. It is not listed on the mock demo (only ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Cartesia, Fish Audio). A direct voice/connect request with provider 'scripted' returned 400 'Unknown voice provider.' So no call can start on this stack, and STORY-EL-1 to 4 cannot be walked. Case B of this story needs a working provider and was also not walked.
expected: Per the story preconditions, Scripted is available.
actual: Scripted absent from the UI and rejected by the API.
suggested_fix: Enable the Scripted provider in the demo stack (or document the env flag the e2e run uses) so the call UI can be walked.
